name: Nathan
source:
Nathan has had a strange rollercoaster of a life, even before the world ended. Married at 18 to his best friend to keep their family out of their hair, they stayed together for two years. They stuck together after the apocalypse, until they came to Home. One morning, he awoke to find they were gone. Instead, there was a note saying they were leaving...and Nathan was not. Since then, he's realized that he hasn't had much time to figure out who he really is without a partner. Since then, he's come out as bi and tried to start relationships with people of all genders. Every time he thinks he's found someone, though, his mind drifts back to the partner that disappeared without a trace...

[Edited from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spincut/who-we-are-now-a-queer-post-apocalyptic-visual-nov]Kickstarter[/url]]
